Select Parties 1.5.1 for Contracts enrollment after the protected [owner release](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Parties/actions/runs/39576141445) published source `8c88c27acd5ed3ee2d2f2b6f51f3432d536f2021`. Fresh verification of the public Contracts archive passes seven strict operations, description lint, approved inventory coverage, and all seven CLI/MCP vectors without dependency overrides.

Regenerate the byte-bound package audit for `hexalith-parties`, preserving other families and historical observations. The existing unresolved Server, ServiceDefaults, and UI catalog identities remain recorded as unresolved; this change adds no package identities or compatibility claims.

Validation: central versions, authoritative catalog, package-audit provenance, consumer package authority, and version-exception inventory pass locally. Both full commit messages pass pinned commitlint.

Merge with a merge commit to preserve the audit's exact catalog-source ancestor `4878668412fe8803c3ef232e1775b1dd09f2f857`.
